import.title: Import Scopus / Web of Science data
import.subtitle: Bring in real citation numbers by exporting a CSV from Scopus or Web of Science (while on your university network) and uploading it here. Everything runs in your browser — the file is never uploaded to any server.
import.instructionsScopus: On Scopus (while connected to your university VPN), open your author profile, select your documents, then Export → CSV — make sure "Cited by" is included in the export fields.
import.instructionsWos: On Web of Science (while connected to your university VPN), open your citation report, select all records, then Export → Excel/CSV with "Times Cited" included.
import.instructionsOther: Upload any CSV with columns for title, year, and citation count — column names are matched automatically.
import.missingColumns: Couldn't find a title and citation-count column in this file. Make sure the export includes those fields.
import.parseError: Couldn't read this file. Make sure it's a CSV export.
import.noRows: No papers found in this file.
import.privacyNote: This file was processed entirely in your browser and was never uploaded anywhere.

manualScore.title: Official H-index (Scopus / Web of Science)
manualScore.subtitle: Optional. Open your real profile, check the number, and enter it here — self-reported, not automatically verified.
manualScore.profileUrlPlaceholder: Paste a link to your Scopus/WOS author profile
manualScore.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number, 0 or higher.
manualScore.disclaimer: Not automatically checked against Scopus/WOS — this app has no way to call their APIs directly. The number and profile link are simply stored as you entered them.

predictor.title: H-index Predictor
predictor.subtitle: Project when you'll hit your target H-index based on citation growth and publication rate.
predictor.noPapersWarning: This researcher has no tracked papers yet, so this projection is based purely on new papers you plan to publish — it won't reflect any existing body of work. Look up a researcher with papers, or use demo data, for a more realistic projection.
predictor.venueTooltip: Sets a multiplier on how fast NEW papers you publish going forward earn citations — Top venue (3x) and Strong venue (2x) speed up the projection, Emerging venue (0.5x) slows it down. It does not change citations on papers you've already published.
predictor.venueHint: A rough heuristic, not a real impact-factor database — only affects how fast new papers you publish going forward accumulate citations.
predictor.saveLoginRequired: Log in and look up a real researcher to save predictions.

predictor.notReachedDesc: Try increasing citation growth or publication rate.
